en: Black‑and‑white riverside scene with a calm body of water in the foreground, reeds along the bank, and a small passenger ferry or barge on the river. On the right is a light-colored arched pedestrian bridge with lattice-like supports spanning the water. Behind the river stands a dense group of large trees partly hiding several structures. On the left side is a multi‑story building with the large sign "ZUR KATZE" on its facade, suggesting an inn or guesthouse. There are also several small signboards near the water's edge.
